thesis: The site is a surveyor's field book rendered as a live instrument: every section is a rod reading taken off a laser level, and the visitor's own numbers sit beside our sample ranges so the call is a verification, not a discovery.

signature.name: rod-reading
signature.summary: A 2px laser-red horizontal rule crosses every section at the header baseline; each section header carries a monospace reading pill aligned to that rule. On scroll the rule wipes in via clip-path driven by --sw-p and the reading ticks from 0.00 to its value. Footer closes with benchmark 0.00. Hook: data-sw-signature='rod-reading'.

palette.family: Graphite Field Book + Laser Red + Gravel Bone

motion.intro: Laser rule sweeps left-to-right across hero once; calculator digits tick to default. ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Pinned grade rod on desktop right margin slides to each section reading on scroll; mobile: stacked cards with clip reveal.
Process cross-section fills layer by layer (cut, footing, backfill lifts, topsoil, seed) synced to scroll.
motion.hover: Hairline grows from left via scaleX(0→1) on buttons and cards.
